title: Early-Duty Month Credit First Counted Day, TRICARE Reserve Select
content:
**Desk guidance - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

Whether the day the early-duty month credit is counted from is itself counted follows the application for that active duty enrollment: where the early-duty month credit is counted from the enrollment's effective date or from the first day of the month and the enrollment was applied for on or before that day, that day is the first day counted; where it is counted from either of those days and the enrollment was applied for after that day, the first day counted is the day after the application date; otherwise the first day counted is the day after the day the early-duty month credit is counted from.

The application date is the date the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment was applied for, as its TRICARE Prime record shows.

## Input - judgement - output (hypothetical, June)

| Counted from | Enrollment applied for | Judgement | First day counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 June, the enrollment's effective date | 2 June | applied on or before that day | 9 June |
| 9 June, the enrollment's effective date | 12 June | applied after that day | 13 June |
| 1 June, the first day of the month | 25 May | applied on or before that day | 1 June |
| 1 June, the first day of the month | 4 June | applied after that day | 5 June |
| 14 June, the plan's termination date | any date | neither of the two days | 15 June |
